title: Prawn and Tomato Trofie Pasta
description: A fresh and flavorful vegetarian pasta dish featuring prawns and trofie pasta, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the trofie pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the prawns to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Add the Italian tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the tomatoes start to break down.
Stir in the chopped basil and reserved pasta water. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Add the cooked trofie pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the tomato sauce.
Serve hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese if desired.
Optional: Add some heat to the dish by sprinkling red pepper flakes on top.
